SR2E.Ware99.Refuse.boostedWired: {name} can't go in beside {other}: boosted reflexes can never be used with wired reflexes (Street Samurai Catalog p. 87)
SR2E.Ware99.Refuse.boostedVcr: {name} can't go in beside {other}: boosted reflexes can never be used with a vehicle control rig (Street Samurai Catalog p. 87)
SR2E.Ware99.Refuse.orthoPlating: {name} can't go in beside {other}: orthoskin is not compatible with dermal plating (Shadowtech p. 17)
SR2E.Ware99.Note.boostedWired: {a} and {b} are both installed, but boosted reflexes can never be used with wired reflexes (Street Samurai Catalog p. 87): only the better reflexes count
SR2E.Ware99.Note.boostedVcr: {a} and {b} are both installed, but boosted reflexes can never be used with a vehicle control rig (Street Samurai Catalog p. 87): the GM decides which one goes
SR2E.Ware99.Note.orthoPlating: Orthoskin and dermal plating don't work together (Shadowtech p. 17): only {better} counts, {worse} gives nothing
SR2E.Ware99.Note.limbStrengthCap: The four limbs' average Strength {average} is over the cap of {cap} (twice Body or Body + 4, Cybertechnology p. 51)
SR2E.Ware99.Note.limbQuicknessCap: The four limbs' average Quickness {average} is over the cap of {cap} (twice Quickness or Quickness + 4, Cybertechnology p. 51)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.WARE_V99__boosted: Boosted reflexes: never with wired reflexes or a control rig, installing the pair refused for players and a sheet warning, SSC p. 87 (book) or allowed (v980)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.WARE_V99__limbs: Cyberlimbs: built-in Strength 3 (troll 8), enhancement past 3 points costs Essence, average caps warned, Cybertechnology pp. 49–51 (book) or the limb's fields as entered (v980)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.WARE_V99__limbLead: Leading with a cyberlimb in melee: + (limb Strength − four limbs' average) TN, Cybertechnology p. 50 (book) or no TN (v980)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.WARE_V99__bioRecove: Recovery after bioware surgery: × 3, cultured × 2, Shadowtech p. 6 (book) or as cyberware (v980)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.WARE_V99__damper: Trauma damper on Stun: one box off, not with a pain editor or an unexceeded damage compensator, Shadowtech p. 29 (book) or its rating in boxes (v980)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.WARE_V99__orthoskin: Orthoskin and dermal plating: installing the pair refused for players, only the better counts, Shadowtech p. 17 (book) or both count (v980)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.WARE_V99__limbStren: Cyberlimbs: built-in Strength for a troll (Cybertechnology p. 51: 8)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.WARE_V99__limbQuick: Cyberlimbs: built-in Quickness (not in the book; 3 like Strength)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.WARE_V99__limbFreeP: Cyberlimbs: enhancement points per limb with no Essence cost (Cybertechnology pp. 50–51: 3)
Cyberlimbs: a troll's Strength points over the built-in 8 with no Essence cost (Cybertechnology p. 51: 0)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.WARE_V99__limbStren: Cyberlimbs: Essence per Strength point past the free ones (Cybertechnology p. 50: .4)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.WARE_V99__limbQuick: Cyberlimbs: Essence per Quickness point past the free ones (Cybertechnology p. 51: .3)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.WARE_V99__bioRecove: Bioware surgery: times the normal recovery (Shadowtech p. 6: 3)
Cultured bioware surgery: times the normal recovery (Shadowtech p. 6: 2)
